name: Feature Card Stack
description: Sticky section heading with dark feature cards that stack over it on scroll; each pinned card scales down to 0.94 as the next slides over (rAF-driven, linear with scroll). Cards alternate text/image and carry an arrow-swap button with a brand gradient glow chip.
interactions: rAF scroll-linked scale 1 -> 0.94 on the covered card
arrow-swap button: icon slides out right, twin slides in from left (.8s expo)
gradient glow chip sharpens on hover (1.2s expo)
